import Foundation

/// Turns a `WorkoutDatabaseEngine.ExercisePrescription` into loggable Workout Hub items.
/// Pure and deterministic so it is easy to test.
enum HubRegimenBuilder {

    struct LiftItem: Equatable, Sendable {
        var name: String
        var sets: Int
        var reps: String
        var intensity: String
    }

    struct RunItem: Equatable, Sendable {
        var label: String
        var target: String
        /// Pre-filled distance when the target states one (e.g. "1 Mile").
        var plannedMiles: Double?
    }

    struct Regimen: Equatable, Sendable {
        var kind: HubWorkoutKind
        var title: String
        var focus: String
        var cue: String
        var isRestDay: Bool
        var lifts: [LiftItem]
        var runs: [RunItem]
    }

    /// Splits combined blocks ("A + B" with reps "3 + 3") into one item per movement.
    static func regimen(
        from prescription: WorkoutDatabaseEngine.ExercisePrescription,
        kind: HubWorkoutKind
    ) -> Regimen {
        let isRest = prescription.sessionType == .activeRecovery || prescription.sessionType == .completeRest
        let names = split(prescription.exercise)
        let reps = split(prescription.reps)
        let title = "\(prescription.dayOfWeek.rawValue) · \(prescription.sessionFocus)"

        switch kind {
        case .lifting:
            let lifts = names.enumerated().map { index, name in
                LiftItem(
                    name: name,
                    sets: max(1, prescription.sets),
                    reps: reps.count == names.count ? reps[index] : prescription.reps,
                    intensity: prescription.intensity
                )
            }
            return Regimen(kind: kind, title: title, focus: prescription.sessionFocus, cue: prescription.cue,
                           isRestDay: isRest, lifts: isRest ? [] : lifts, runs: [])

        case .running:
            var runs: [RunItem] = []
            for (index, name) in names.enumerated() {
                let target = reps.count == names.count ? reps[index] : (index == 0 ? prescription.reps : "As prescribed")
                // The lead block repeats `sets` times (e.g. 4 × 1 Mile); extra blocks are one segment.
                let count = index == 0 ? max(1, prescription.sets) : 1
                for rep in 1...count {
                    let label = count > 1 ? "\(name) · Rep \(rep) of \(count)" : name
                    runs.append(RunItem(
                        label: label,
                        target: "\(target) · \(prescription.intensity)",
                        plannedMiles: plannedMiles(from: target)
                    ))
                }
            }
            return Regimen(kind: kind, title: title, focus: prescription.sessionFocus, cue: prescription.cue,
                           isRestDay: isRest, lifts: [], runs: isRest ? [] : runs)
        }
    }

    /// Fallback when there is no prescription or the user picks "Free workout".
    static func freeWorkout(kind: HubWorkoutKind) -> Regimen {
        switch kind {
        case .running:
            return Regimen(kind: kind, title: "Free Run", focus: "Free run", cue: "Log distance and time; pace is calculated.",
                           isRestDay: false, lifts: [], runs: [RunItem(label: "Run", target: "Any distance", plannedMiles: nil)])
        case .lifting:
            return Regimen(kind: kind, title: "Free Lift", focus: "Free lift", cue: "Add exercises and log each set.",
                           isRestDay: false, lifts: [], runs: [])
        }
    }

    static func split(_ text: String) -> [String] {
        text.components(separatedBy: " + ")
            .map { $0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) }
            .filter { !$0.isEmpty }
    }

    /// Reads "1 Mile", "3 miles", "400m", "5K" targets into miles; time targets return `nil`.
    static func plannedMiles(from target: String) -> Double? {
        let lower = target.lowercased()
        let number = Double(lower.prefix { "0123456789.".contains($0) }) ?? (lower.hasPrefix("mile") ? 1 : nil)
        guard let number else { return nil }
        if lower.contains("mile") { return number }
        if lower.contains("km") || lower.hasSuffix("k") { return number * 0.621371 }
        if lower.contains("m") && !lower.contains("min") { return number / 1609.344 }
        return nil
    }
}

import Foundation
import SwiftData

// SwiftData models for Workout Hub: a session (running or lifting) owns exercises/sets or run segments.
// Finished sessions are the workout log history; each also writes a `WorkoutRecord` so wear,
// weekly stats, and WSL pick it up.

enum HubWorkoutKind: String, Codable, CaseIterable, Sendable, Identifiable {
    case running
    case lifting

    var id: String { rawValue }

    var title: String {
        switch self {
        case .running: return "Running"
        case .lifting: return "Lifting"
        }
    }

    var symbol: String {
        switch self {
        case .running: return "figure.run"
        case .lifting: return "dumbbell.fill"
        }
    }

    /// Regimen bank this kind draws from.
    var sport: AthleteOnboardingEngine.SportDiscipline {
        switch self {
        case .running: return .running
        case .lifting: return .powerlifting
        }
    }

    /// `WorkoutRecord.type` written on finish (matches wear mapper and weekly builders).
    var recordType: String {
        switch self {
        case .running: return "running"
        case .lifting: return "strength"
        }
    }
}

/// One workout from Start to Finish.
@Model
final class HubSession {
    @Attribute(.unique) var id: UUID
    var kindRaw: String
    var title: String
    var focus: String?
    var cue: String?
    var startedAt: Date
    /// `nil` while the workout is in progress.
    var endedAt: Date?
    var notes: String?
    @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \HubExercise.session)
    var exercises: [HubExercise]
    @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \HubRunSegment.session)
    var runSegments: [HubRunSegment]

    init(
        id: UUID = UUID(),
        kind: HubWorkoutKind,
        title: String,
        focus: String? = nil,
        cue: String? = nil,
        startedAt: Date = .now
    ) {
        self.id = id
        self.kindRaw = kind.rawValue
        self.title = title
        self.focus = focus
        self.cue = cue
        self.startedAt = startedAt
        self.endedAt = nil
        self.exercises = []
        self.runSegments = []
    }

    var kind: HubWorkoutKind { HubWorkoutKind(rawValue: kindRaw) ?? .lifting }
    var isActive: Bool { endedAt == nil }

    var sortedExercises: [HubExercise] { exercises.sorted { $0.sortIndex < $1.sortIndex } }
    var sortedSegments: [HubRunSegment] { runSegments.sorted { $0.index < $1.index } }

    var durationMinutes: Double {
        max(0, (endedAt ?? .now).timeIntervalSince(startedAt) / 60)
    }

    /// Completed lifting volume (lbs × reps).
    var totalVolumeLbs: Double {
        exercises.flatMap(\.sets).reduce(0) { $0 + $1.volumeLbs }
    }

    var completedSetCount: Int {
        exercises.flatMap(\.sets).filter(\.isCompleted).count
    }

    var completedSegments: [HubRunSegment] {
        runSegments.filter { $0.isCompleted && ($0.distanceMiles ?? 0) > 0 }
    }

    var totalMiles: Double {
        completedSegments.compactMap(\.distanceMiles).reduce(0, +)
    }

    /// Total timed seconds across completed segments that have a time.
    var totalRunSeconds: Double {
        completedSegments.compactMap(\.durationSeconds).reduce(0, +)
    }

    /// Average pace (seconds per mile) over completed segments with both distance and time.
    var averagePaceSecondsPerMile: Double? {
        let timed = completedSegments.filter { ($0.durationSeconds ?? 0) > 0 }
        let miles = timed.compactMap(\.distanceMiles).reduce(0, +)
        let seconds = timed.compactMap(\.durationSeconds).reduce(0, +)
        guard miles > 0, seconds > 0 else { return nil }
        return seconds / miles
    }
}

@Model
final class HubExercise {
    @Attribute(.unique) var id: UUID
    /// Start-of-day for the session (local calendar).
    var sessionDay: Date
    var name: String
    var sortIndex: Int
    /// Regimen target, e.g. sets 5 and reps "3".
    var targetSets: Int?
    var targetReps: String?
    var targetIntensity: String?
    @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \HubSetLog.exercise)
    var sets: [HubSetLog]
    var session: HubSession?

    init(
        id: UUID = UUID(),
        sessionDay: Date,
        name: String,
        sortIndex: Int,
        targetSets: Int? = nil,
        targetReps: String? = nil,
        targetIntensity: String? = nil,
        sets: [HubSetLog] = []
    ) {
        self.id = id
        self.sessionDay = sessionDay
        self.name = name
        self.sortIndex = sortIndex
        self.targetSets = targetSets
        self.targetReps = targetReps
        self.targetIntensity = targetIntensity
        self.sets = sets
    }

    var sortedSets: [HubSetLog] { sets.sorted { $0.setNumber < $1.setNumber } }

    /// "5 × 3 · 85% 1RM" style target line.
    var targetLine: String? {
        var parts: [String] = []
        if let targetSets, let targetReps { parts.append("\(targetSets) × \(targetReps)") }
        else if let targetReps { parts.append(targetReps) }
        if let targetIntensity, !targetIntensity.isEmpty { parts.append(targetIntensity) }
        return parts.isEmpty ? nil : parts.joined(separator: " · ")
    }
}

@Model
final class HubSetLog {
    @Attribute(.unique) var id: UUID
    var setNumber: Int
    /// `nil` with `usesBodyweight == true` displays as BW.
    var weightLbs: Double?
    var usesBodyweight: Bool
    var reps: Int
    var isCompleted: Bool
    var exercise: HubExercise?

    init(
        id: UUID = UUID(),
        setNumber: Int,
        weightLbs: Double?,
        usesBodyweight: Bool = false,
        reps: Int,
        isCompleted: Bool = false,
        exercise: HubExercise? = nil
    ) {
        self.id = id
        self.setNumber = setNumber
        self.weightLbs = weightLbs
        self.usesBodyweight = usesBodyweight
        self.reps = reps
        self.isCompleted = isCompleted
        self.exercise = exercise
    }

    var weightDisplay: String {
        if usesBodyweight { return "BW" }
        if let weightLbs { return HubFormat.weight(weightLbs) }
        return "—"
    }

    var volumeLbs: Double {
        guard isCompleted else { return 0 }
        let load = usesBodyweight ? 0 : (weightLbs ?? 0)
        return load * Double(reps)
    }
}

/// One running interval or block (e.g. "Rep 2 of 4 · 1 Mile").
@Model
final class HubRunSegment {
    @Attribute(.unique) var id: UUID
    var index: Int
    var label: String
    var target: String?
    var distanceMiles: Double?
    var durationSeconds: Double?
    var averageHeartRate: Double?
    var isCompleted: Bool
    var session: HubSession?

    init(
        id: UUID = UUID(),
        index: Int,
        label: String,
        target: String? = nil,
        distanceMiles: Double? = nil,
        durationSeconds: Double? = nil,
        averageHeartRate: Double? = nil,
        isCompleted: Bool = false
    ) {
        self.id = id
        self.index = index
        self.label = label
        self.target = target
        self.distanceMiles = distanceMiles
        self.durationSeconds = durationSeconds
        self.averageHeartRate = averageHeartRate
        self.isCompleted = isCompleted
    }

    /// Seconds per mile when both distance and time are logged.
    var paceSecondsPerMile: Double? {
        guard let distanceMiles, distanceMiles > 0, let durationSeconds, durationSeconds > 0 else { return nil }
        return durationSeconds / distanceMiles
    }
}

enum HubWorkoutCalendar {
    static func startOfDay(_ date: Date = .now, calendar: Calendar = .current) -> Date {
        calendar.startOfDay(for: date)
    }
}

@Model
final class HubSession {
    @Attribute(.unique) var id: UUID
    var kindRaw: String
    var title: String
    var focus: String?
    var cue: String?
    var startedAt: Date
    /// `nil` while the workout is in progress.
    var endedAt: Date?
    var notes: String?
    @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \HubExercise.session)
    var exercises: [HubExercise]
    @Relationship(deleteRule: .cascade, inverse: \HubRunSegment.session)
    var runSegments: [HubRunSegment]

    init(
        id: UUID = UUID(),
        kind: HubWorkoutKind,
        title: String,
        focus: String? = nil,
        cue: String? = nil,
        startedAt: Date = .now
    ) {
        self.id = id
        self.kindRaw = kind.rawValue
        self.title = title
        self.focus = focus
        self.cue = cue
        self.startedAt = startedAt
        self.endedAt = nil
        self.exercises = []
        self.runSegments = []
    }

    var kind: HubWorkoutKind { HubWorkoutKind(rawValue: kindRaw) ?? .lifting }
    var isActive: Bool { endedAt == nil }

    var sortedExercises: [HubExercise] { exercises.sorted { $0.sortIndex < $1.sortIndex } }
    var sortedSegments: [HubRunSegment] { runSegments.sorted { $0.index < $1.index } }

    var durationMinutes: Double {
        max(0, (endedAt ?? .now).timeIntervalSince(startedAt) / 60)
    }

    /// Completed lifting volume (lbs × reps).
    var totalVolumeLbs: Double {
        exercises.flatMap(\.sets).reduce(0) { $0 + $1.volumeLbs }
    }

    var completedSetCount: Int {
        exercises.flatMap(\.sets).filter(\.isCompleted).count
    }

    var completedSegments: [HubRunSegment] {
        runSegments.filter { $0.isCompleted && ($0.distanceMiles ?? 0) > 0 }
    }

    var totalMiles: Double {
        completedSegments.compactMap(\.distanceMiles).reduce(0, +)
    }

    /// Total timed seconds across completed segments that have a time.
    var totalRunSeconds: Double {
        completedSegments.compactMap(\.durationSeconds).reduce(0, +)
    }

    /// Average pace (seconds per mile) over completed segments with both distance and time.
    var averagePaceSecondsPerMile: Double? {
        let timed = completedSegments.filter { ($0.durationSeconds ?? 0) > 0 }
        let miles = timed.compactMap(\.distanceMiles).reduce(0, +)
        let seconds = timed.compactMap(\.durationSeconds).reduce(0, +)
        guard miles > 0, seconds > 0 else { return nil }
        return seconds / miles
    }
}

    var targetLine: String? {

        else if let targetReps { parts.append(targetReps) }
        if let targetIntensity, !targetIntensity.isEmpty { parts.append(targetIntensity) }

    }

    }

        if let weightLbs { return HubFormat.weight(weightLbs) }
        return "—"
    }

    var volumeLbs: Double {
        guard isCompleted else { return 0 }
        let load = usesBodyweight ? 0 : (weightLbs ?? 0)
        return load * Double(reps)
    }
}

        guard let distanceMiles, distanceMiles > 0, let durationSeconds, durationSeconds > 0 else { return nil }
        return durationSeconds / distanceMiles
    }
}

    func classifyTier(for prescription: ExercisePrescription) -> ExerciseTier {
        if prescription.sessionType == .activeRecovery || prescription.sessionType == .completeRest {
            return .recoveryModality

        if prescription.sport == .running {

        // whole string misfired: "...Ab Crunch" contains "run" (-> unbounded endurance progression on a
        // barbell accessory) and "Close Grip Bench Press + Barbell Seal Row" matched the row first.
        let full = prescription.exercise.lowercased()
        let lead = full.components(separatedBy: " + ").first ?? full
        func has(_ keywords: String...) -> Bool { keywords.contains { lead.contains($0) } }

        if has("clean", "jump", "slam", "hop") {
            return .ballisticPower
        } else if has("split squat", "lunge", "single-leg") {
            return .unilateralStrength
        } else if has("curl", "lateral raise", "seal row", "calf") {
            return .hypertrophyPump
        } else if has("competition", "squat", "deadlift", "bench") || (has("press") && !has("pallof")) {
            return .compoundStrength
        } else {
            return .accessoryRotational
        }
    }

    func generateOverloadPrescription(
        for prescription: ExercisePrescription,
        weekNumber: Int,
        baselineLoadLbs: Double = 100.0,
        wslScaleRank: WSLScaleRank = .midTierPlayer
    ) -> DynamicWorkoutOutput {
        let tier = classifyTier(for: prescription)

        if tier == .recoveryModality {
            return DynamicWorkoutOutput(
                original: prescription,
                currentWeek: weekNumber,
                prescribedSets: prescription.sets,
                prescribedReps: prescription.reps,
                prescribedWeightLbs: 0.0,
                intensityLabel: prescription.intensity,
                overloadStatus: "[wuhu.ai] RESTORATION MODALITY: Optimize parasympathetic recovery, zero weight overload."
            )
        }

        guard let rule = Repository.rules.first(where: { $0.tier == tier }) else {
            return DynamicWorkoutOutput(
                original: prescription,
                currentWeek: weekNumber,
                prescribedSets: prescription.sets,
                prescribedReps: prescription.reps,
                prescribedWeightLbs: baselineLoadLbs,
                intensityLabel: prescription.intensity,
                overloadStatus: "Standard Prescription"
            )
        }

        let wslScaleFactor: Double
        let wslNote: String
        switch wslScaleRank {
        case .subPlayer:
            wslScaleFactor = 0.65
            wslNote = "Sub-Player: Regressed volume/load (-35%) to protect tendons & build structural base."
        case .lowTierPlayer:
            wslScaleFactor = 0.85
            wslNote = "Low Tier Player: Controlled load (-15%) for form mastery."
        case .midTierPlayer:
            wslScaleFactor = 1.0
            wslNote = "Mid Tier Player: Standard athletic benchmark prescription."
        case .highTierPlayer:
            wslScaleFactor = 1.15
            wslNote = "High Tier Player: Elevated volume (+15%) matching proven work capacity."
        case .goatLite:
            wslScaleFactor = 1.25
            wslNote = "GOAT Lite: Elite loading (+25%) with high velocity intent."
        case .trueGoat:
            wslScaleFactor = 1.35
            wslNote = "True GOAT: Apex physical capacity (+35%). Maximum force output."
        }

        let adjustedBaseline = baselineLoadLbs * wslScaleFactor

        let isDeloadWeek = (weekNumber % rule.deloadFrequencyWeeks == 0)
        if isDeloadWeek {
            let reducedSets = max(1, Int(round(Double(prescription.sets) * (1.0 - rule.deloadVolumeDropPercent))))
            let reducedLoad = adjustedBaseline * (1.0 - rule.deloadIntensityDropPercent)
            return DynamicWorkoutOutput(
                original: prescription,
                currentWeek: weekNumber,
                prescribedSets: reducedSets,
                prescribedReps: prescription.reps,
                prescribedWeightLbs: reducedLoad,
                intensityLabel: "Deload Active (-10% Load)",
                overloadStatus: "[wuhu.ai] DELOAD MICROCYCLE: Volume -\(Int(rule.deloadVolumeDropPercent * 100))%, Load -\(Int(rule.deloadIntensityDropPercent * 100))%"
            )
        }

        // Progression cadence: a tier only steps its load every `cadenceWeeks` weeks (1 = every week).
        // This field was defined on every rule but never read, so 2-week tiers progressed weekly.
        let cadence = max(1, rule.cadenceWeeks)
        let isProgressionWeek = ((weekNumber - 1) % cadence == 0)

        let recentLog = userLogs.filter { $0.exerciseName.lowercased() == prescription.exercise.lowercased() }.last
        var percentIncrease = 0.0
        var status = "\(wslNote) Load Maintained (Consolidating motor patterns)"

        if let log = recentLog {
            if !isProgressionWeek {
                status = "\(wslNote) CADENCE HOLD: this tier steps load every \(cadence) weeks."
            } else if log.achievedReps >= log.targetReps && log.rpeLogged <= 7.5 {
                percentIncrease = rule.weeklyPercentIncreaseMax
                status = "\(wslNote) CLEARED (+): Optimal recovery (RPE \(log.rpeLogged)). Overload +\(String(format: "%.1f", percentIncrease * 100))%"
            } else if log.achievedReps >= log.targetReps && log.rpeLogged <= 8.5 {
                percentIncrease = rule.weeklyPercentIncreaseMin
                status = "\(wslNote) CLEARED: Target met (RPE \(log.rpeLogged)). Overload +\(String(format: "%.1f", percentIncrease * 100))%"
            } else if log.rpeLogged >= 9.0 || log.achievedReps < log.targetReps {
                percentIncrease = 0.0
                status = "\(wslNote) HOLD LOAD: Fatigue spike / RPE high (\(log.rpeLogged)). Form recovery required."
            }
        } else {
            let progressionSteps = max(0, weekNumber - 1) / cadence
            percentIncrease = min(Double(progressionSteps) * rule.weeklyPercentIncreaseMin, 0.08)
            status = "\(wslNote) Programmatic linear projection"
        }

        let rawWeightJump = adjustedBaseline * percentIncrease
        let cappedWeightJump = (rule.maxWeightJumpLbs > 0.0) ? min(rawWeightJump, rule.maxWeightJumpLbs) : rawWeightJump
        let finalWeight = adjustedBaseline + cappedWeightJump

        return DynamicWorkoutOutput(
            original: prescription,
            currentWeek: weekNumber,
            prescribedSets: prescription.sets,
            prescribedReps: prescription.reps,
            prescribedWeightLbs: finalWeight,
            intensityLabel: "\(prescription.intensity) (+\(String(format: "%.1f", cappedWeightJump)) lbs/vol)",
            overloadStatus: status
        )
    }

    func fetchWorkouts(for sport: AthleteOnboardingEngine.SportDiscipline) -> [ExercisePrescription] {
        return exerciseBank.filter { $0.sport == sport }
    }
}

        static func buildWeeklyExerciseBank() -> [ExercisePrescription] {

Prioritize 8+ hours sleep and nutrient-dense hydration")

            // 1. RUNNING
            add7DayPlan(
                sport: .running, phase: "Aerobic Base & Lactate Threshold",

                tue: ("Easy Recovery Run & Strides", .secondaryVolume, "A1", "Easy Zone 2 Run + 4 x 100m Fast Strides", 1, "35 mins", "Zone 2", 60, "Flush legs; smooth fast turnover without straining"),
                wed: standardActiveRecovery,
                thu: ("Aerobic Hill Repeats & Calf Durability", .primaryLift, "A1", "Short Hill Sprints + Eccentric Calf Drops", 6, "45s hill + 15 drops", "RPE 8.5", 90, "Drive knees high; strengthen Achilles tendon"),
                fri: ("Mid-Distance Aerobic Flush Run", .secondaryVolume, "A1", "Steady Aerobic Base Run", 1, "40-45 mins", "Zone 2", 0, "Consistent rhythm; conversational nasal breathing"),

                sun: standardCompleteRest
            )

            // 2. POWERLIFTING
            add7DayPlan(
                sport: .powerlifting, phase: "Competition SBD Peaking",

                tue: ("Upper Body Accessory & Shoulder Health", .secondaryVolume, "A1", "Chest-Supported DB Rear Delt Flye + Skullcrushers", 4, "12 + 10", "RPE 7.5", 75, "Stabilize posterior shoulder shelf"),

                fri: ("Secondary Bench & Tricep Lockout Volume", .secondaryVolume, "A1", "Close Grip Bench Press + Barbell Seal Row", 4, "5 + 8", "77.5% 1RM", 120, "Reinforce lockout power and back rigidity"),
                sat: ("Hip Hinge Overload & Trunk Rigidity", .primaryLift, "A1", "Barbell Glute Bridge + Standing Cable Ab Crunch", 3, "6 + 12", "RPE 8", 90, "Strengthen deadlift lockout without spinal wear"),
                sun: standardCompleteRest

            return bank

    private(set) var exerciseBank: [ExercisePrescription]
    private(set) var userLogs: [CompletedSetLog] = []

    init(customBank: [ExercisePrescription]? = nil) {
        self.exerciseBank = customBank ?? WorkoutPrescriptionLoader.loadFromBundle()
    }

    func logSession(exercise: String, targetReps: Int, achievedReps: Int, rpe: Double, loadLbs: Double) {
        let entry = CompletedSetLog(
            exerciseName: exercise,
            timestamp: Date(),
            targetReps: targetReps,
            achievedReps: achievedReps,
            rpeLogged: rpe,
            loadUsedLbs: loadLbs
        )
        userLogs.append(entry)
    }

    func classifyTier(for prescription: ExercisePrescription) -> ExerciseTier {
        if prescription.sessionType == .activeRecovery || prescription.sessionType == .completeRest {
            return .recoveryModality
        }
        // Every running session is aerobic work. (Name matching alone misfires: "Calf Drops" looked like
        // a calf-raise accessory and landed in the hypertrophy tier.)
        if prescription.sport == .running {
            return .enduranceAerobic
        }

        // Combined blocks ("Primary + Secondary") are classified by their LEAD movement. Matching the
        // whole string misfired: "...Ab Crunch" contains "run" (-> unbounded endurance progression on a
        // barbell accessory) and "Close Grip Bench Press + Barbell Seal Row" matched the row first.
        let full = prescription.exercise.lowercased()
        let lead = full.components(separatedBy: " + ").first ?? full
        func has(_ keywords: String...) -> Bool { keywords.contains { lead.contains($0) } }

        if has("clean", "jump", "slam", "hop") {
            return .ballisticPower
        } else if has("split squat", "lunge", "single-leg") {
            return .unilateralStrength
        } else if has("curl", "lateral raise", "seal row", "calf") {
            return .hypertrophyPump
        } else if has("competition", "squat", "deadlift", "bench") || (has("press") && !has("pallof")) {
            return .compoundStrength
        } else {
            return .accessoryRotational
        }
    }

    func generateOverloadPrescription(
        for prescription: ExercisePrescription,
        weekNumber: Int,
        baselineLoadLbs: Double = 100.0,
        wslScaleRank: WSLScaleRank = .midTierPlayer
    ) -> DynamicWorkoutOutput {
        let tier = classifyTier(for: prescription)

        if tier == .recoveryModality {
            return DynamicWorkoutOutput(
                original: prescription,
                currentWeek: weekNumber,
                prescribedSets: prescription.sets,
                prescribedReps: prescription.reps,
                prescribedWeightLbs: 0.0,
                intensityLabel: prescription.intensity,
                overloadStatus: "[wuhu.ai] RESTORATION MODALITY: Optimize parasympathetic recovery, zero weight overload."
            )
        }

        guard let rule = Repository.rules.first(where: { $0.tier == tier }) else {
            return DynamicWorkoutOutput(
                original: prescription,
                currentWeek: weekNumber,
                prescribedSets: prescription.sets,
                prescribedReps: prescription.reps,
                prescribedWeightLbs: baselineLoadLbs,
                intensityLabel: prescription.intensity,
                overloadStatus: "Standard Prescription"
            )
        }

        let wslScaleFactor: Double
        let wslNote: String
        switch wslScaleRank {
        case .subPlayer:
            wslScaleFactor = 0.65
            wslNote = "Sub-Player: Regressed volume/load (-35%) to protect tendons & build structural base."
        case .lowTierPlayer:
            wslScaleFactor = 0.85
            wslNote = "Low Tier Player: Controlled load (-15%) for form mastery."
        case .midTierPlayer:
            wslScaleFactor = 1.0
            wslNote = "Mid Tier Player: Standard athletic benchmark prescription."
        case .highTierPlayer:
            wslScaleFactor = 1.15
            wslNote = "High Tier Player: Elevated volume (+15%) matching proven work capacity."
        case .goatLite:
            wslScaleFactor = 1.25
            wslNote = "GOAT Lite: Elite loading (+25%) with high velocity intent."
        case .trueGoat:
            wslScaleFactor = 1.35
            wslNote = "True GOAT: Apex physical capacity (+35%). Maximum force output."
        }

        let adjustedBaseline = baselineLoadLbs * wslScaleFactor

        let isDeloadWeek = (weekNumber % rule.deloadFrequencyWeeks == 0)
        if isDeloadWeek {
            let reducedSets = max(1, Int(round(Double(prescription.sets) * (1.0 - rule.deloadVolumeDropPercent))))
            let reducedLoad = adjustedBaseline * (1.0 - rule.deloadIntensityDropPercent)
            return DynamicWorkoutOutput(
                original: prescription,
                currentWeek: weekNumber,
                prescribedSets: reducedSets,
                prescribedReps: prescription.reps,
                prescribedWeightLbs: reducedLoad,
                intensityLabel: "Deload Active (-10% Load)",
                overloadStatus: "[wuhu.ai] DELOAD MICROCYCLE: Volume -\(Int(rule.deloadVolumeDropPercent * 100))%, Load -\(Int(rule.deloadIntensityDropPercent * 100))%"
            )
        }

        // Progression cadence: a tier only steps its load every `cadenceWeeks` weeks (1 = every week).
        // This field was defined on every rule but never read, so 2-week tiers progressed weekly.
        let cadence = max(1, rule.cadenceWeeks)
        let isProgressionWeek = ((weekNumber - 1) % cadence == 0)

        let recentLog = userLogs.filter { $0.exerciseName.lowercased() == prescription.exercise.lowercased() }.last
        var percentIncrease = 0.0
        var status = "\(wslNote) Load Maintained (Consolidating motor patterns)"

        if let log = recentLog {
            if !isProgressionWeek {
                status = "\(wslNote) CADENCE HOLD: this tier steps load every \(cadence) weeks."
            } else if log.achievedReps >= log.targetReps && log.rpeLogged <= 7.5 {
                percentIncrease = rule.weeklyPercentIncreaseMax
                status = "\(wslNote) CLEARED (+): Optimal recovery (RPE \(log.rpeLogged)). Overload +\(String(format: "%.1f", percentIncrease * 100))%"
            } else if log.achievedReps >= log.targetReps && log.rpeLogged <= 8.5 {
                percentIncrease = rule.weeklyPercentIncreaseMin
                status = "\(wslNote) CLEARED: Target met (RPE \(log.rpeLogged)). Overload +\(String(format: "%.1f", percentIncrease * 100))%"
            } else if log.rpeLogged >= 9.0 || log.achievedReps < log.targetReps {
                percentIncrease = 0.0
                status = "\(wslNote) HOLD LOAD: Fatigue spike / RPE high (\(log.rpeLogged)). Form recovery required."
            }
        } else {
            let progressionSteps = max(0, weekNumber - 1) / cadence
            percentIncrease = min(Double(progressionSteps) * rule.weeklyPercentIncreaseMin, 0.08)
            status = "\(wslNote) Programmatic linear projection"
        }

        let rawWeightJump = adjustedBaseline * percentIncrease
        let cappedWeightJump = (rule.maxWeightJumpLbs > 0.0) ? min(rawWeightJump, rule.maxWeightJumpLbs) : rawWeightJump
        let finalWeight = adjustedBaseline + cappedWeightJump

        return DynamicWorkoutOutput(
            original: prescription,
            currentWeek: weekNumber,
            prescribedSets: prescription.sets,
            prescribedReps: prescription.reps,
            prescribedWeightLbs: finalWeight,
            intensityLabel: "\(prescription.intensity) (+\(String(format: "%.1f", cappedWeightJump)) lbs/vol)",
            overloadStatus: status
        )
    }

    func fetchWorkouts(for sport: AthleteOnboardingEngine.SportDiscipline) -> [ExercisePrescription] {
        return exerciseBank.filter { $0.sport == sport }
    }
}

import Foundation

/// Running and powerlifting onboarding + multi-factor WSL composite (R2). No CLI.
enum AthleteOnboardingEngine {

        case male = "Male"
        case female = "Female"
    }

    enum ActivityLevel: String, Codable, CaseIterable, Sendable {
        case sedentary = "Sedentary (Desk job, minimal activity)"
        case lightlyActive = "Lightly Active (1-3 light sessions/week)"
        case moderatelyActive = "Moderately Active (3-5 sport/gym sessions/week)"
        case veryActive = "Very Active (6-7 intense sessions/week)"
        case competitivePlayer = "Competitive Player (2x day training / collegiate / pro)"
    }

    enum SportDiscipline: String, Codable, CaseIterable, Sendable {
        case running = "Running"
        case powerlifting = "Powerlifting"
    }

    enum PrimaryGoal: String, Codable, CaseIterable, Sendable {
        case explosivePower = "Explosive Power & Rate of Force Development"
        case maxStrength = "Maximal Strength & 1RM Progression"
        case hypertrophy = "Hypertrophy & Muscle Volume (Aesthetics)"
        case aerobicEndurance = "Aerobic Base, VO2 Max & Mileage Capacity"
        case speedAgilityDecel = "Sprint Acceleration & Deceleration Durability"
        case jointResilience = "Rotator Cuff & Joint Durability"
        case anaerobicConditioning = "Lactate Tolerance & Alactic Capacity"
    }

    enum DayOfWeek: String, Codable, CaseIterable, Sendable {
        case monday = "Monday"
        case tuesday = "Tuesday"
        case wednesday = "Wednesday"
        case thursday = "Thursday"
        case friday = "Friday"
        case saturday = "Saturday"
        case sunday = "Sunday"

        static func from(date: Date, calendar: Calendar = .current) -> DayOfWeek {
            switch calendar.component(.weekday, from: date) {
            case 1: return .sunday
            case 2: return .monday
            case 3: return .tuesday
            case 4: return .wednesday
            case 5: return .thursday
            case 6: return .friday
            default: return .saturday
            }
        }

        var shortLabel: String { rawValue }
    }

    struct PlayerProfile: Codable, Sendable, Equatable {
        var name: String
        var gender: Gender
        var age: Int
        var heightInches: Double
        var weightLbs: Double
        var activityLevel: ActivityLevel
        var selectedSport: SportDiscipline
        var goals: [PrimaryGoal]
        var wslEvaluation: WSLCompositeEvaluation?

        var formattedHeight: String {
            let feet = Int(heightInches) / 12
            let inches = Int(heightInches) % 12
            return "\(feet)'\(inches)\""
        }

        var bmi: Double {
            guard heightInches > 0 else { return 0 }
            return (weightLbs / (heightInches * heightInches)) * 703.0
        }

        var weightKg: Double { weightLbs * 0.45359237 }
    }

    enum OnboardingError: Error, LocalizedError {
        case invalidName
        case invalidAge
        case invalidHeight
        case invalidWeight
        case noGoalsSelected

        var errorDescription: String? {
            switch self {
            case .invalidName: return "Player name cannot be blank."
            case .invalidAge: return "Age must be between 10 and 100."
            case .invalidHeight: return "Height must be between 36 and 96 inches."
            case .invalidWeight: return "Weight must be between 50 and 500 lbs."
            case .noGoalsSelected: return "Select at least one development goal."
            }
        }
    }

    static func defaultGoals(for sport: SportDiscipline) -> [PrimaryGoal] {
        switch sport {
        case .running: return [.aerobicEndurance, .anaerobicConditioning]
        case .powerlifting: return [.maxStrength, .jointResilience]
        }
    }

    static func evaluateCompositeWSL(
        sport: SportDiscipline,
        gender: Gender,
        age: Int,
        bodyweightLbs: Double,
        heightInches: Double,
        primaryVal: Double,
        subMetricA: Double?,
        subMetricB: Double?
    ) -> WSLCompositeEvaluation {
        var subMetrics: [SubMetric] = []
        var optionalInputsUsed = 0

        switch sport {
        case .running:
            let fiveK = primaryVal
            let fiveKScore: Double
            if gender == .male {
                if fiveK >= 32.0 { fiveKScore = 1.0 }
                else if fiveK >= 26.0 { fiveKScore = 2.0 }
                else if fiveK >= 21.0 { fiveKScore = 3.0 }
                else if fiveK >= 18.0 { fiveKScore = 4.0 }
                else if fiveK >= 15.5 { fiveKScore = 5.0 }
                else { fiveKScore = 6.0 }
            } else {
                if fiveK >= 35.5 { fiveKScore = 1.0 }
                else if fiveK >= 29.0 { fiveKScore = 2.0 }
                else if fiveK >= 23.5 { fiveKScore = 3.0 }
                else if fiveK >= 20.0 { fiveKScore = 4.0 }
                else if fiveK >= 17.2 { fiveKScore = 5.0 }
                else { fiveKScore = 6.0 }
            }
            subMetrics.append(SubMetric(
                name: "5K Race Time (\(gender.rawValue))", rawValue: fiveK, unit: "min",
                score: fiveKScore, weight: 0.40, notes: "WMA sex-calibrated lactate threshold velocity"
            ))

            let ageFactor: Double
            if age <= 25 { ageFactor = 1.0 }
            else if age <= 35 { ageFactor = 0.98 }
            else if age <= 45 { ageFactor = 0.92 }
            else if age <= 55 { ageFactor = 0.85 }
            else { ageFactor = 0.77 }

            let ageAdjustedTime = fiveK * ageFactor
            let ageGradeScore: Double
            if gender == .male {
                if ageAdjustedTime >= 30.0 { ageGradeScore = 1.0 }
                else if ageAdjustedTime >= 24.5 { ageGradeScore = 2.0 }
                else if ageAdjustedTime >= 20.0 { ageGradeScore = 3.0 }
                else if ageAdjustedTime >= 17.0 { ageGradeScore = 4.0 }
                else if ageAdjustedTime >= 15.0 { ageGradeScore = 5.0 }
                else { ageGradeScore = 6.0 }
            } else {
                if ageAdjustedTime >= 33.5 { ageGradeScore = 1.0 }
                else if ageAdjustedTime >= 27.5 { ageGradeScore = 2.0 }
                else if ageAdjustedTime >= 22.5 { ageGradeScore = 3.0 }
                else if ageAdjustedTime >= 19.0 { ageGradeScore = 4.0 }
                else if ageAdjustedTime >= 16.8 { ageGradeScore = 5.0 }
                else { ageGradeScore = 6.0 }
            }
            subMetrics.append(SubMetric(
                name: "Age & Sex Graded Factor", rawValue: ageAdjustedTime, unit: "adj-min",
                score: ageGradeScore, weight: 0.35,
                notes: "World Masters Athletics standard for \(gender.rawValue) age \(age)"
            ))

            if let rhr = subMetricA {
                optionalInputsUsed += 1
                let rhrScore: Double
                if gender == .male {
                    if rhr > 75.0 { rhrScore = 1.0 }
                    else if rhr > 64.0 { rhrScore = 2.0 }
                    else if rhr > 54.0 { rhrScore = 3.0 }
                    else if rhr > 46.0 { rhrScore = 4.0 }
                    else if rhr > 40.0 { rhrScore = 5.0 }
                    else { rhrScore = 6.0 }
                } else {
                    if rhr > 78.0 { rhrScore = 1.0 }
                    else if rhr > 68.0 { rhrScore = 2.0 }
                    else if rhr > 58.0 { rhrScore = 3.0 }
                    else if rhr > 50.0 { rhrScore = 4.0 }
                    else if rhr > 44.0 { rhrScore = 5.0 }
                    else { rhrScore = 6.0 }
                }
                subMetrics.append(SubMetric(
                    name: "Resting Heart Rate", rawValue: rhr, unit: "bpm",
                    score: rhrScore, weight: 0.25, notes: "Autonomic tone & stroke volume"
                ))
            }

        case .powerlifting:
            let total = primaryVal
            let bwKg = max(40.0, bodyweightLbs * 0.45359237)

            let rawScore: Double
            if gender == .male {
                if total < 600.0 { rawScore = 1.0 }
                else if total < 900.0 { rawScore = 2.0 }
                else if total < 1200.0 { rawScore = 3.0 }
                else if total < 1500.0 { rawScore = 4.0 }
                else if total < 1800.0 { rawScore = 5.0 }
                else { rawScore = 6.0 }
            } else {
                if total < 400.0 { rawScore = 1.0 }
                else if total < 600.0 { rawScore = 2.0 }
                else if total < 800.0 { rawScore = 3.0 }
                else if total < 1000.0 { rawScore = 4.0 }
                else if total < 1200.0 { rawScore = 5.0 }
                else { rawScore = 6.0 }
            }
            subMetrics.append(SubMetric(
                name: "Raw SBD Total (\(gender.rawValue))", rawValue: total, unit: "lbs",
                score: rawScore, weight: 0.35,
                notes: "Absolute load for biological \(gender.rawValue)"
            ))

            let totalKg = total * 0.45359237
            let denom: Double
            if gender == .male {
                let boundedBw = min(210.0, max(40.0, bwKg))
                denom = (-0.0000010930 * pow(boundedBw, 4)) + (0.0007391293 * pow(boundedBw, 3))
                    + (-0.1918759221 * pow(boundedBw, 2)) + (24.0900756 * boundedBw) - 307.75076
            } else {
                let boundedBw = min(150.0, max(40.0, bwKg))
                denom = (-0.0000010706 * pow(boundedBw, 4)) + (0.0005158568 * pow(boundedBw, 3))
                    + (-0.1126655495 * pow(boundedBw, 2)) + (13.6175032 * boundedBw) - 57.96288
            }

import Foundation

/// Builds a WSL composite from whatever data exists, estimating (interpolating) missing fields
/// so the Home card never stalls on "Collecting profile".
///
/// Resolution order per field: player profile → Apple Health → app settings → population estimate.
/// Every estimated field is listed in `WSLAutoResult.estimatedFields` and lowers confidence.
/// The final number still comes from `AthleteOnboardingEngine.evaluateCompositeWSL`.
enum WSLAutoEvaluator {

    /// One logged strength set (Workout Hub).
    struct LiftSet: Sendable, Equatable {
        var exerciseName: String
        var weightLbs: Double
        var reps: Int
    }

    struct Input: Sendable {
        var profile: AthleteOnboardingEngine.PlayerProfile?
        var healthProfile: UserProfile
        var settingsAge: Int
        var settingsSex: String
        var settingsHeightCm: Double
        var settingsWeightKg: Double
        var dailyHistory: [DailyStats]
        var workouts: [ImportedWorkout]
        var liftSets: [LiftSet]
    }

    struct Result: Sendable, Equatable {
        var evaluation: WSLCompositeEvaluation
        /// Human-readable names of inputs that were estimated, e.g. "5K time".
        var estimatedFields: [String]
    }

    // MARK: - Tunables (documented estimates, not measurements)

    enum Config {
        static let fiveKMiles = 3.10686
        /// Riegel endurance exponent for race-time prediction.
        static let riegelExponent = 1.06
        static let minRunMiles = 0.6
        static let fiveKRangeMinutes = 12.0...60.0
        /// Recreational 5K medians by sex (minutes) before activity/age adjustment.
        static let baseFiveKMale = 30.0
        static let baseFiveKFemale = 35.0
        static let fiveKAgePenaltyPerYearOver30 = 0.15
        static let fiveKPerRHRBeatAbove60 = 0.1
        static let rhrWindowDays = 14
        static let epleyMaxReps = 12
        /// Reference S/B/D share of total (matches the engine's structural ratio).
        static let maleRatio = (squat: 0.35, bench: 0.24, deadlift: 0.41)
        static let femaleRatio = (squat: 0.36, bench: 0.20, deadlift: 0.44)
    }

    // MARK: - Entry point

    static func evaluate(_ input: Input) -> Result {
        var estimated: [String] = []
        var measuredWeight = 0.0
        var totalWeight = 0.0

        /// Tracks how much of the score rests on real data (weights sum to 1).
        func track(_ name: String, measured: Bool, weight: Double) {
            totalWeight += weight
            if measured { measuredWeight += weight } else { estimated.append(name) }
        }

        let age = resolveAge(input)
        track("age", measured: age.measured, weight: 0.05)

        let sex = resolveSex(input)
        track("sex", measured: sex != nil, weight: 0.05)

        let weightLbs = resolveWeightLbs(input)
        let heightInches = resolveHeightInches(input)
        track("body size", measured: weightLbs.measured && heightInches.measured, weight: 0.05)

        let sport = resolveSport(input)
        track("sport", measured: sport.measured, weight: 0.05)

        let activity = resolveActivityLevel(input)
        track("activity level", measured: activity.measured, weight: 0.05)

        let evaluations: [WSLCompositeEvaluation]
        let genders: [AthleteOnboardingEngine.Gender] = sex.map { [$0] } ?? [.male, .female]

        gender: AthleteOnboardingEngine.Gender,
        bodyweightLbs: Double,
        activity: AthleteOnboardingEngine.ActivityLevel
    ) -> Lifts {
        let ratio = gender == .male ? Config.maleRatio : Config.femaleRatio
        let squat = bestE1RM(input.liftSets, matching: ["squat"], excluding: ["split", "goblet"])
        let bench = bestE1RM(input.liftSets, matching: ["bench"], excluding: ["dumbbell"])
        let deadlift = bestE1RM(input.liftSets, matching: ["deadlift"], excluding: ["romanian", "rdl", "stiff"])

        let found: [(Double, Double)] = [(squat, ratio.squat), (bench, ratio.bench), (deadlift, ratio.deadlift)]
            .compactMap { lift, share in lift.map { ($0, share) } }

        let total: Double
        if found.isEmpty {
            // Interpolate from bodyweight × typical total multiple for the activity level.
            let multiple: Double
            switch (gender, activity) {
            case (.male, .sedentary): multiple = 2.0
            case (.male, .lightlyActive): multiple = 2.6
            case (.male, .moderatelyActive): multiple = 3.2
            case (.male, .veryActive): multiple = 3.8
            case (.male, .competitivePlayer): multiple = 4.6
            case (.female, .sedentary): multiple = 1.4
            case (.female, .lightlyActive): multiple = 1.8
            case (.female, .moderatelyActive): multiple = 2.3
            case (.female, .veryActive): multiple = 2.8
            case (.female, .competitivePlayer): multiple = 3.4
            }
            total = bodyweightLbs * multiple
        } else {
            // Scale the lifts we have up to a full total using reference shares.
            let liftSum = found.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.0 }
            let shareSum = found.reduce(0) { $0 + $1.1 }
            total = liftSum / shareSum
        }

        return Lifts(
            total: total,
            squat: squat ?? total * ratio.squat,
            bench: bench ?? total * ratio.bench,
            measuredCount: found.count
        )
    }

    /// Best estimated one-rep max (Epley: w × (1 + reps / 30)) for matching exercises.
    private static func bestE1RM(_ sets: [LiftSet], matching: [String], excluding: [String]) -> Double? {
        sets.compactMap { set -> Double? in
            let name = set.exerciseName.lowercased()
            guard matching.contains(where: name.contains),
                  !excluding.contains(where: name.contains),
                  set.weightLbs > 0, (1...Config.epleyMaxReps).contains(set.reps) else { return nil }
            return set.reps == 1 ? set.weightLbs : set.weightLbs * (1 + Double(set.reps) / 30)
        }.max()
    }

    // MARK: - Merge

    /// Averages male/female evaluations when sex is unknown; passes a single evaluation through.
    private static func average(_ evaluations: [WSLCompositeEvaluation]) -> WSLCompositeEvaluation {
        guard evaluations.count > 1, let first = evaluations.first else {
            return evaluations[0]
        }
        let composite = evaluations.map(\.compositeScore).reduce(0, +) / Double(evaluations.count)
        let sameShape = evaluations.allSatisfy { $0.subMetrics.count == first.subMetrics.count }
        let subMetrics: [SubMetric] = sameShape
            ? first.subMetrics.indices.map { index in
                let scores = evaluations.map { $0.subMetrics[index].score }
                let base = first.subMetrics[index]
                return SubMetric(
                    name: base.name.replacingOccurrences(of: " (Male)", with: ""),
                    rawValue: base.rawValue, unit: base.unit,
                    score: scores.reduce(0, +) / Double(scores.count),
                    weight: base.weight,
                    notes: base.notes + " (averaged across sexes)"
                )
            }
            : first.subMetrics
        let rank = WSLScaleRank.from(compositeScore: composite)
        return WSLCompositeEvaluation(
            sport: first.sport,
            gender: first.gender,
            compositeScore: composite,
            rank: rank,
            confidencePercentage: first.confidencePercentage,
            isProvisional: true,
            subMetrics: subMetrics,
            feedbackComment: feedback(for: rank)
        )
    }

    /// Same tier copy as the engine, for averaged results.
    private static func feedback(for rank: WSLScaleRank) -> String {
        switch rank {
        case .subPlayer: return "Sub-Player: Foundation phase needed. Focus on mobility and core."
        case .lowTierPlayer: return "Low Tier Player: Early motor competence. Linear overload will accelerate rank."
        case .midTierPlayer: return "Mid Tier Player: Well-rounded athleticism and conditioning balance."
        case .highTierPlayer: return "High Tier Player: Advanced performer with strong work capacity."
        case .goatLite: return "GOAT Lite: Elite regional powerhouse across force-velocity metrics."
        case .trueGoat: return "True GOAT: Apex performance in the 99th percentile composite."
        }
    }
}

/// Starts, updates, and ends the workout Live Activity so the session stays visible on the
/// Lock Screen and Dynamic Island while the app is in the background or closed.
@MainActor
enum WorkoutLiveActivityController {

    private static func activity(for sessionID: UUID) -> Activity<WorkoutActivityAttributes>? {
        Activity<WorkoutActivityAttributes>.activities.first { $0.attributes.sessionID == sessionID }
    }

    static func start(_ session: HubSession) {
        guard ActivityAuthorizationInfo().areActivitiesEnabled, activity(for: session.id) == nil else {
            update(session)
            return
        }
        let attributes = WorkoutActivityAttributes(
            sessionID: session.id,
            title: session.title,
            symbol: session.kind.symbol
        )
        let content = ActivityContent(state: state(for: session), staleDate: nil)
        _ = try? Activity.request(attributes: attributes, content: content, pushType: nil)
    }

    static func update(_ session: HubSession) {
        guard let activity = activity(for: session.id) else { return }
        let content = ActivityContent(state: state(for: session), staleDate: nil)
        Task { await activity.update(content) }
    }

    static func end(sessionID: UUID) {
        guard let activity = activity(for: sessionID) else { return }
        Task { await activity.end(nil, dismissalPolicy: .immediate) }
    }

    /// On launch: keep exactly one activity for the in-progress session (restarts it if the
    /// system removed it) and end any left over from finished or deleted sessions.
    static func reconcile(activeSession: HubSession?) {
        for activity in Activity<WorkoutActivityAttributes>.activities
        where activity.attributes.sessionID != activeSession?.id {
            Task { await activity.end(nil, dismissalPolicy: .immediate) }
        }
        if let activeSession {
            start(activeSession)
        }
    }

    private static func state(for session: HubSession) -> WorkoutActivityAttributes.ContentState {
        WorkoutActivityAttributes.ContentState(startedAt: session.startedAt, detail: detail(for: session))
    }

    static func detail(for session: HubSession) -> String {
        switch session.kind {
        case .lifting:
            let total = session.exercises.flatMap(\.sets).count
            return "\(session.completedSetCount)/\(total) sets · \(HomeFormat.grouped(Int(session.totalVolumeLbs.rounded()))) lbs"
        case .running:
            var text = HubFormat.miles(session.totalMiles)
            if let pace = session.averagePaceSecondsPerMile { text += " · \(HubFormat.pace(pace))" }
            return text
        }
    }
}

Let me check the live activity controller and WorkoutHubView briefly to anchor answers 1 and 3 precisely.I now have a solid picture of the actual architecture. Here's my grounded guidance.

## 1) Wiring the live session engine with @Observable + SwiftData

Your current design is already the right spine — keep it. `HubSession`/`HubExercise`/`HubSetLog` are `@Model`, `ActiveWorkoutView` binds directly with `@Bindable var session`, edits save immediately through `HubSessionService`, and the view drives the Live Activity via `.onChange(of: totalsText)`. The principle to hold: **SwiftData is the single source of persistent truth; `HubSessionService` owns all writes; the view owns only ephemeral UI state.**

Where state should live:

- **Persistent workout state** (sets, reps, weights, completion, segments) → SwiftData models, mutated only through `HubSessionService`. Do not mirror these into a separate `@Observable` session engine; that creates two sources of truth you'll have to reconcile. Set completion is just `set.isCompleted = true` + `context.save()` — add a `HubSessionService.complete(_ set:in:)` so completion and the resulting Live Activity update flow through the service, not ad-hoc in the view.
- **Rest timer** → this is the one piece that is genuinely *not* persistent domain data and doesn't belong in a `@Model`. Put it in a small `@MainActor @Observable RestTimerModel` owned by `ActiveWorkoutView` as `@State`. It holds `endsAt: Date`, derives remaining time, and fires a local notification + `WorkoutLiveActivityController.update` on expiry. If you want it to survive the app being backgrounded, persist only `endsAt` (e.g. a field on `HubSession` like `restEndsAt: Date?`) and let the timer model read it on appear — store the deadline, not a ticking countdown.
- **Live Activity** → keep it as the side-effect layer it already is. `WorkoutLiveActivityController` is correctly stateless and derives everything from the `HubSession`. One improvement: the view currently calls `update` on a `totalsText` change; route set-completion and rest-timer events through the service so the service calls `update`, keeping the view from orchestrating.

Concretely, to avoid view bloat: move the set-completion/add-set/rest-start logic that's inline in `ActiveWorkoutView` / `LiftExerciseCard` into `HubSessionService` methods that each do mutate → save → `WorkoutLiveActivityController.update`. The view then only toggles bindings and reads derived computed properties (`completedSetCount`, `totalVolumeLbs`) that already live on the model. No ViewModel layer is needed here — `@Model` + `@Bindable` + a service enum is the idiomatic iOS 18 pattern and you're already on it.

## 2) Spec-driven next steps for full onboarding UI

The engine (`AthleteOnboardingEngine`) and persistence (`PlayerProfileStore`) are complete and already encode sex as a first-class `Gender` field that the WSL math branches on. What's missing is only the UI and the write path. Spec tasks, in dependency order:

1. **Onboarding flow shell** — a `@Observable OnboardingDraft` holding the in-progress answers (name, age, height, weight, activity, sport, and the raw WSL inputs). This is ephemeral UI state, not persisted until the end. Sex asked *first* is correct and matters: every WSL branch (`evaluateCompositeWSL`) and the running/powerlifting standards are sex-calibrated, so collect `Gender` before any metric screen so downstream screens can show sex-specific reference bands.
2. **Sport + metric capture screens** — running asks 5K time (+ optional RHR); powerlifting asks SBD total (+ optional squat/bench). Map these directly to `primaryVal` / `subMetricA` / `subMetricB`. Surface the "optional inputs raise confidence" relationship in the UI so users understand provisional vs firm.
3. **Finish → persist** — call `makeProfile(...)` (which validates and throws the typed `OnboardingError`s), attach the `WSLCompositeEvaluation` from `evaluateCompositeWSL`, then `PlayerProfileStore.save`. Surface the thrown errors inline per field.
4. **WSL battery visualization** — render `WSLCompositeEvaluation.subMetrics` as a bar/radar battery: each `SubMetric` has `name`, `score` (1–6), `weight`, `notes`, and `rawValue`/`unit`. Show the composite as the six-tier ladder (`WSLScaleRank.title`) with the `confidencePercentage` and the `isProvisional` "estimated" badge. This reuses `WSLScorePresentation.from(evaluation:)` that Home already uses.
5. **Reconcile Home's two paths** — today Home can show an *estimated* score from `WSLAutoEvaluator` (resolves profile → Health → settings → population) while `PlayerProfileStore.wslPresentation()` returns the *stored* profile eval. Spec a rule: completed onboarding profile is authoritative; `WSLAutoEvaluator` only fills in when `profile == nil` or a profile field is absent. Make the "estimated" badge consistent across the onboarding battery and the Home card so the same number never appears with two confidences.

Note one existing subtlety to document in the spec: `AutoEvaluator` averages male+female scales when sex is unknown. Once onboarding makes sex mandatory-first, that averaging path only applies to the pre-onboarding Home estimate — keep it, but the onboarding result should never be sex-averaged.

## 3) prescriptions.json → engine → "Today's Workout" pill (single source of truth)

The pipeline already exists and the boundaries are clean — the task is to *reuse* it, not re-derive R2 logic in the view. The flow:

`workout_prescriptions.json` → `WorkoutPrescriptionLoader.loadFromBundle()` (falls back to `Repository.buildWeeklyExerciseBank()` if the bundle file is missing/empty) → `WorkoutDatabaseEngine.exerciseBank`.

For "Today's Workout":

- **Selection boundary** — `WorkoutDatabaseEngine` is the only thing that knows the bank. Add one method there: `prescription(for sport:on date:)` that filters `exerciseBank` by `sport` and `DayOfWeek.from(date:)` (that helper already exists on the enum). Pass the user's sport from `PlayerProfileStore.profile?.selectedSport` (the `HubWorkoutKind.sport` mapping already bridges kind↔sport). Don't let the view filter the bank itself.
- **Overload boundary** — if the pill shows prescribed load, go through `generateOverloadPrescription(for:weekNumber:wslScaleRank:)`. That's the one place progression/deload/WSL-scaling lives; the view must not recompute weights. Feed it `wslScaleRank` from the stored evaluation's `rank`.
- **Display boundary** — `HubRegimenBuilder.regimen(from:kind:)` is the one translator from an `ExercisePrescription` to displayable/loggable items. The pill should show `Regimen.title`/`focus` from that, and "Start" hands the same `Regimen` to `HubSessionService.start`. This guarantees the pill preview and the started session are identical — no divergence.

So the only new surface is `WorkoutDatabaseEngine.prescription(for:on:)` plus a tiny view that renders a `Regimen` and a Start button. Everything downstream is already wired. The single source of truth: JSON is data, `WorkoutDatabaseEngine` owns selection + progression, `HubRegimenBuilder` owns presentation translation, `HubSessionService` owns the write. No R2 monolith logic gets duplicated because the view touches none of it.

## 4) Property-based testing targets

These are both pure/deterministic (`HubRegimenBuilder` is explicitly documented as such, and the WSL engine and progression rules are pure functions), so they're ideal for property tests with randomized inputs (Swift Testing with generated values, or swift-check-style loops over random seeds).

**WSL composite clamping / invariants** (`evaluateCompositeWSL`, `WSLScaleRank.from`):
- For any valid inputs, `compositeScore` stays within the 1.0–6.0 band (each `SubMetric.score` is 1–6 and normalized weights sum to 1, so the weighted sum can never leave [1,6]). Assert it.
- Normalized `subMetric` weights always sum to ~1.0 (within epsilon) whenever any sub-metric exists.
- `rank == WSLScaleRank.from(compositeScore:)` — the returned rank is always consistent with the score, and the `from` thresholds are total and monotonic: a higher score never maps to a lower rank.
- Monotonicity of performance → score: for powerlifting, increasing `total` with all else fixed never decreases `compositeScore`; for running, decreasing 5K time never decreases it. (Guards against a mis-ordered threshold band.)
- Confidence invariants: `confidencePercentage ∈ {40,70,100}` by optional-input count for the engine, and `isProvisional == (confidence < 70)`.
- `WSLAutoEvaluator` clamp: `clampedConfidence ∈ [15,100]` for any input, and `estimatedFields` is non-empty whenever confidence < 100.

**Progressive overload rules** (`generateOverloadPrescription`):
- Weight-jump cap: for any tier with `maxWeightJumpLbs > 0`, `finalWeight - adjustedBaseline ≤ maxWeightJumpLbs` always holds.
- Non-negative progression: `finalWeight ≥ adjustedBaseline` on progression, and on a deload week `prescribedWeightLbs < adjustedBaseline` and `prescribedSets ≥ 1` (the `max(1, …)` floor).
- Recovery tiers: for `activeRecovery`/`completeRest`, `prescribedWeightLbs == 0` for *all* week numbers and WSL ranks.
- Cadence honoring: for a tier with `cadenceWeeks == 2`, load only steps on weeks where `(week-1) % 2 == 0` — i.e. two consecutive non-deload weeks never both increase load. (This is the exact bug the inline comment calls out.)
- Deload periodicity: a deload fires iff `week % deloadFrequencyWeeks == 0`, and never coincides with a load increase.
- WSL scaling monotonic: higher `wslScaleRank` yields `adjustedBaseline` that is ≥ the lower rank's, across all ranks (0.65 → 1.35 ladder).
- RPE gating: given a logged set, RPE ≥ 9.0 or `achievedReps < targetReps` always yields zero increase (hold), and RPE ≤ 7.5 with target met yields the max increase — never the reverse.

Also worth a property test on `classifyTier`: every running prescription classifies to `.enduranceAerobic`, and combined blocks classify by lead movement (the two misfires documented in the comments — "Ab Crunch" matching "run", seal-row ordering — make good explicit regression cases).

## 5) Privacy split — validation and leaks to avoid

The intended split holds and the code mostly enforces it: raw HealthKit and Hub SwiftData logs stay on device, and only compact summaries (`HealthSnapshot`, schema v1) plus the `WuhuChatContext` dossier go to Gemini. `HealthSnapshot` is already a deliberately reduced projection (aggregates and rounded metrics, not raw samples), which is the correct shape to send. Confirm these boundaries in the spec and watch for these specific leaks:

- **PII in the dossier.** `WuhuChatContext.systemPromptSection` sends `profile.name`, exact age, exact bodyweight, BMI, and biological sex to Gemini on every chat. Decide deliberately whether name needs to leave the device — it almost certainly doesn't help coaching. Prefer sending sex/age-band/weight rather than name + exact values, or gate name behind a setting.
- **Free-text leakage.** `HubSession.notes`, `HubExercise`/exercise names typed by the user, and `summary(session)` can contain anything a user types. If any of these feed chat context, they bypass the structured snapshot. Keep the chat context assembled only from the typed `HealthSnapshot`/dossier structs — never splice in raw model notes.
- **Snapshot scope creep.** `HealthSnapshot` currently excludes raw per-sample data by design. The leak risk is future fields: if someone adds `bedtime`/`wakeTime` (already present) plus precise timestamps, you start transmitting location-adjacent routine data. Keep the snapshot to aggregates and keep `SnapshotDataQuality.missingMetrics` as *metric names*, never values.
- **Diagnostics endpoints.** You have `GeminiChatDiagnostics` and `HealthDataDiagnostics` — make sure diagnostic/logging paths don't serialize the full snapshot or raw HealthKit into logs that leave the device (crash reporters, analytics). On-device logs are fine; exported ones are the risk.
- **Transport.** Confirm the Gemini client only sends the assembled context and user turns, with the key from `Secrets.xcconfig` (not committed). Nothing in `HealthKitManager` should have a network path — verify HealthKit data only ever reaches the network *after* passing through the `HealthSnapshot` reducer.

Net: the architecture is sound. The concrete action items are (a) trim name/exact PII from the chat dossier, (b) guarantee free-text notes/exercise names never enter chat context, and (c) assert in a test that the only outbound payload is `HealthSnapshot` + dossier — no raw `HubSetLog`/`WorkoutRecord`/HealthKit samples.
